title: Swiss watch exports rose 9.1% in October.
hook: Key number, stated plainly: CHF 2.46bn in October, up 9.1% year on year.
why: MARKET fallback, since no headline qualifies. Useful to collectors and trade readers. Caveat: no source confirms a fifth consecutive month, so that claim is left out.
